# relations-matrix

Patch rows on this catalog use `"catalog": "relations-matrix"` and a `key` from the records below (here the key is the race key). The catalog is closed: a mod changes values with patch rows (see [Patch operations](patch-ops.md)) and cannot add records.

## Records

`abyssars`, `cognars`, `corvani`, `custom`, `drakhals`, `ferrans`, `humans`, `kodrani`, `orelins`, `pardari`, `silicoids`, `tolmens`, `umbrals`, `vesparis`

## Copy this row

A row that changes nothing: `value` and `expect` both hold the base value. Change `value` to the number you want.

```json
{
  "op": "set",
  "catalog": "relations-matrix",
  "key": "abyssars",
  "path": "toward",
  "value": [{"race":"corvani","value":24},{"race":"kodrani","value":0},{"race":"umbrals","value":0},{"race":"orelins","value":0},{"race":"tolmens","value":0},{"race":"humans","value":0},{"race":"vesparis","value":24},{"race":"ferrans","value":-12},{"race":"pardari","value":12},{"race":"cognars","value":12},{"race":"drakhals","value":0},{"race":"silicoids","value":0},{"race":"abyssars","value":0},{"race":"custom","value":0}],

}
```
